_doc: Maintained team-name aliases for matchid.team_key. Exact names only (matched after the same normalisation as HLTV names: case, accents, punctuation). Each entry maps a platform's spelling to ONE HLTV team id and records its proof (same fixture: same opponent, same start, same event). Never add an alias for a generic name ('Orgless') or an academy / junior / female / NXT squad onto its main team.

_renames_doc: Dated team renames for matchid.canonical_match (match-rules-3), keyed on HLTV team ids, never a name alias: a platform name that resolves to from_team_id, for a match starting on/after valid_from (UTC date), links to the to_team_id HLTV match ONLY when from_team_id has no HLTV match of that opponent within the window and to_team_id has exactly one. Team identity (team_key, same_team, history and stats reads) is unchanged.
